answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and draws one fresh timber job each epoch from a pool dealt by the gale, each keyed to the epoch seed, never dealt twice. A filing counts only if its yarrow stamp matches a finished, client-signed job. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 distinct jobs, about 40 hours of work, plus 38 each, 38,000 total, against a 40,000 pool. Renting one job burns both bonds. Honest agents do one job, pay 38, keep the bond.
